_what: Speech enhancement on this Mac (computer/speech-enhance.mjs): interchangeable tiers that clean a recording before it is heard, chosen by what this Mac can afford, and a voice-activity pass that says where speech is. A tier is a row: `cost` is the relative CPU it needs, `filter` is the ffmpeg audio filter chain (`{model}` is filled from `model_file`), `needs_filters` are ffmpeg filters that must exist, `model_file` (under `models_folder`) must be present when the row names one, so a model is data fetched and dropped in, never a rebuild. `cpu_budget` is how much cost the person lets enhancement use (a number, or `cores_over` cores per unit of cost when null). The tier chosen is the most expensive one that fits the budget and whose needs are met; none fits means no enhancement and `why` says so. `vad` is the silence-detect pass: speech is what lies between silences.

tiers.label: Light noise removal and quieter voices gated (shared rooms)

words.no_ffmpeg: This Mac has no ffmpeg to clean sound with.
words.over_budget: every tier costs more than the budget {budget}
words.missing_needs: the tiers within the budget need {needs}, which this Mac does not have
